issues.message: Authentication and user management features are missing from requirements despite database schema including users table with email/password_hash and design showing login/logout functionality
Users table is missing name/display name fields required by User Profile screen design which displays 'user's full name'
No feature defined for user registration, login, or profile management despite design including complete User Profile screen with logout functionality
Design includes 'Clear All' button for completed tasks feature that is not defined in requirements
Design references Edit Task screen and edit functionality but no edit feature is defined in requirements (only create, complete, delete, list)
Character limits specified in design (255 for title, 1000 for description) are not enforced as CHECK constraints in database schema
No storage mechanism defined for user profile pictures/avatars shown in User Profile screen design
Non-functional requirements (NFRs) such as performance targets, security requirements, and scalability expectations are not explicitly defined
API endpoint specifications and error handling requirements are not documented
No updated_at timestamp field in tasks table to track when tasks are modified

required_fixes: Add authentication features to requirements: F5 - User Registration (sign up with email/password), F6 - User Login (authenticate and access tasks), F7 - User Logout (end session)
Add user name fields to database schema: Add 'first_name' VARCHAR(100) and 'last_name' VARCHAR(100) columns to users table
Add Edit Task feature to requirements: F8 - Task Editing with user stories and acceptance criteria for modifying task title and description
Add 'Clear All Completed Tasks' feature to requirements or remove from design
Add CHECK constraints to database schema: title VARCHAR(255) CHECK (LENGTH(title) <= 255), description TEXT CHECK (LENGTH(description) <= 1000)

Define non-functional requirements section covering: authentication security (password hashing, session management), performance (response times, concurrent users), data validation, and error handling
recommendations: Add profile picture support: Include 'avatar_url' VARCHAR(500) column in users table and define image upload/storage strategy (local storage, S3, etc.)
Add updated_at timestamp to tasks table to track modification history: 'updated_at' TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
Consider adding soft delete functionality: Add 'deleted_at' TIMESTAMP NULL column to tasks table to support task recovery and audit trails instead of hard deletion
Define API contract: Document REST API endpoints with request/response schemas, status codes, and error responses for all CRUD operations
Add data validation rules: Specify email format validation, password strength requirements (minimum length, complexity), and task title/description sanitization rules
Consider adding task priority and due date fields to database schema to support future enhancements mentioned in feature priorities
Add database indexes: Create composite index on tasks(user_id, created_at DESC) to optimize task listing queries ordered by creation date
